components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that moves the user forward.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b1a3a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #0b1a3a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 17px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #172b50; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82621f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions next to a primary one.

components.css: .ds-band { background: #0b1a3a; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; display: grid; gap: 10px; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-row span { color: #b7c0d4; font: 700 13px 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-track { display: flex; gap: 4px; height: 22px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; background: #071230; } .ds-bar { min-width: 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--c); border-radius: 3px; } .ds-bar.ds-done { background: var(--c); } .ds-bar.ds-next { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #c9a14e; }

narrative.overview: Bridge's identity is the brand kit in brand/: a navy arch over a gold deck, Midnight Navy and Signature Gold on ivory. The direction is pinned by that kit: ivory page, white cards, navy text and navy CTAs, thin warm borders, gold only for important accents. A career switch is a crossing from where you are to what's next, so the roadmap is drawn as a span: four week rows inside one navy band, each task a bar sized by its minutes, coloured by its kind and filled when done, and the one gold thing on the band is the next step. The world lends four things only: type, palette, density, and that signature move. Navigation, forms and controls stay the standard web ones people already know.
keyCharacteristics: The navy span band holding the target role in Literata, the editorial voice.
The growing calendar: task bars sized by minutes, coloured by kind, outline when to-do, filled when done, a gold ring and "Next" pin on the next bar.
White panels with 1px warm rules on an ivory ground; no glass, no gradients in the UI.
Inter for headings, controls and reading text.
The logo drawn inline from the kit's vector, never retyped.
Tap-to-choose pills instead of typed answers.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: Each screen has at most one navy band, and it holds the identity (the target role, or the sample plan on the landing page). Everything else sits on white panels.

rules.name: The Gold Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Gold appears in the logo and on the next step, nothing else in light mode.

rules.name: The Colour Has A Job Rule
rules.body: Navy means "act here" or "this is the shell". Kind colours mean a task kind. Amber and red mean state. A colour that only decorates is removed.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Literata names the destination and nothing else. Every other line is Inter.

rules.name: The One Size In Lists Rule
rules.body: Task lists use one text size; rank comes from weight, never from size jumps.

dos: Do show the next action before anything else on the roadmap.
Do keep done tasks in place with a flat "Done" tag; nothing disappears.
Do carry state by form first (outline, filled, ringed), colour second.
Do label sample or AI-generated content where a visitor could mistake it.
Do use the logo files from brand/; never redraw or retype the logo in CSS or a font.
donts: Don't put a small label or kicker above a heading; put the context inline or below.
Don't add bridge illustrations or decorative arches; the world lives in type, palette, the logo and the calendar bars only.
Don't use gradients, metallic gold, glass, glow or decorative stripes in the UI; gridlines must measure something.
Don't use gold for small text on ivory, or for anything but the logo and the next step.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons.
Don't invent salaries, prices, durations or success scores to fill a panel.
